proposal.reason: Primary change is communicator-level configuration control: new/validated config fields (nChannelsPerNetPeer, graphUsageMode, maxP2pPeers, nvlinkCentricSched), env overrides, defaults, and cross-rank propagation are implemented in init/comm lifecycle paths. enqueue is additionally needed because graphUsageMode now changes strong-stream acquire/release and capture-mixing behavior in enqueue/strongstream call paths, which is substantive runtime enqueue behavior. device-topology is additionally needed because P2P per-peer channel computation now incorporates nChannelsPerNetPeer/maxP2pPeers policy and caps/tuning in graph path/channel computation logic.
